tests.D: Installed native apps and essential TV functions

lg-webos.method: LG IPK + read-only discovery service; opt-in persistent activities; optional native home category with exact probes
limits: Requires already established root for full discovery and Home integration
Overlay Home (e.g. webOS 5) is rejected by the current planner
Standby/Quick Start+, cold boot, input focus and streaming are unverified
Stock LG Home is retained; no bind mounts/system partition patches

development_evidence.official_simulator: webOS TV 26 Simulator 1.5.0: 9 UI/RCU checks; unmocked LG bridge
development_evidence.installation_and_home: Not verified: simulator runs a source directory, not target-TV IPK installation
development_evidence.cross_app_launch: Simulator returned returnValue=true but created no target app page; not verified

samsung-tizen.method: Opt-in foreground watcher with persistent app-private configuration, positive known-Home detection, bounded requests and cancellation; native Home route not automated
limits: Watcher cannot reliably infer Home for apps hiding visibility
CleanFrame native technique is firmware-specific and uses an undocumented execution workaround
No native writes/exploit execution or new model compatibility has been enabled

development_evidence.physical_home: Not verified; watcher is limited and does not change native Home routing

amazon-fireos.method: Separate Fire OS APK; explicit opted-in boot receiver and accessibility Home redirect; identity-bound activation and restoration
limits: Android-based Fire OS only, min SDK 26
Fire-specific boot receiver implemented and compiled; Android/Fire OS background-start policy and service binding require hardware validation
Fire OS 7 may delay launches; no instant behavior is guaranteed
No physical Fire TV tested; service binding/key delivery must be checked

development_evidence.apk: HorizonX-FireOS-3.8.0-fire.1.apk: release compiled, signature and shared assets verified
development_evidence.simulations: 13 host-JVM startup rules; 15 Python activation/restore/cleanup tests
development_evidence.android_tv: 58 original source/resource files retain their initial SHA256; Android release builds successfully

amazon-vega.method: Existing separate React Native prototype only; no verified Home-assignment API
limits: No VPKG built here
Vega developer commands (vda) exist; they are not Android ADB or proof of root access
Current main-Home objective unsupported by our implementation, not a universal impossibility claim

roku-os.method: Existing limited channel/screensaver; no current verified Home replacement
limits: RootMyRoku is historical: RokuOS 9.4.0 build 4200/Realtek, broken in OS 10
Historical exploit blocks Roku services and does not implement HorizonX Home
In-app ECP is unsupported; an external launch request does not replace Home

development_evidence.ui_emulation: brs-engine SceneGraph beta, Spanish/English navigation and no runtime errors; see validation report

hisense-vidaa.method: Existing limited hosted web app; native application control/Home watcher via external MQTT server researched
limits: Zfinix takeover requires an always-on external host; does not meet standalone requirement
Sidee persistent tiles are not persistent Home routing
No automatic Appinfo.json writes or exploits have been added
VIDAA native launches not implemented in HorizonX standalone adapter
